items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: They didn’t want Quincy producing Michael [Jackson] because he was a jazz guy.

ctx.x: Yeah, Quincy does that. Exactly. Exactly. They didn’t want Quincy producing Michael [Jackson] because he was a jazz guy. They didn’t want him doing “Off the Wall.” Michael had to fight for Quincy to do “Off the Wall,” because he was the jazz guy. He never really did R&B like that you know. And boom.
